title: C2MS 내부 특징과 넓은 문맥을 쓰는 고주파 밴드 비율 헤드
hypothesis: In experiment 61 a 9x9-receptive-field head that saw only the C2MS output, the PAN high band and the LMS color recovered < 2% of the high-band band-ratio headroom (QB SAM -0.040 deg vs the -2.11 deg oracle). Either the information was missing (the head did not see the 64-channel C2MS features) or the context was too small; a 2x2 factorial separates the two.
control: C2MS QB seed 42 (53 best.pt), frozen; the same-seed C2MS output is the epoch-0 reference of every arm

fixed_from_61.output: y' = L + |H| * normalize(r + delta_perp) (band-ratio head; 61 H2 beat the free residual H3)
fixed_from_61.loss: MSE only on the original and the 2x coarser pairs (61: the angle loss did not lower SAM further and pushed the observation ratio above 1.10)
fixed_from_61.selection: minimum validation SAM among epochs whose validation PSNR >= epoch-0 (C2MS) validation PSNR - 0.02 dB; epoch 0 if none qualifies; test never used

arms.F0: 61 head inputs, local head (3x3 conv x4, 32 channels, receptive field 9x9) = 61 H1 rerun
arms.F1: 61 head inputs, wide head (2-level U-Net 32/48/64 channels, additive skips, bilinear upsampling, receptive field 31x31)
arms.F2: 61 head inputs + the 64-channel C2MS backbone output (original + W2 branch, full resolution, before the SSAI fusion), local head
arms.F3: 61 head inputs + C2MS backbone features, wide head

phase1.status: screen approved by the user on 2026-10-26: QB seed 42, F0-F3
phase1.c2ms: frozen (eval mode, no gradient), run online every step in FP32 with TF32 off for every arm, so all arms see identical inputs; the backbone output is read with a forward hook
phase1.train_probe: every epoch, PSNR/SAM of 1,905 fixed training patches (evenly spaced indices) are logged next to validation, to separate a capacity/information limit from a generalization limit
phase1.evaluation: control C2MS and C2MS + selected head on all 20 QB RR/FR test scenes: RR, RR2, FR_WALD, FR with OBS_RMSE_DN (v2.3 inputs)

gates.rule: fixed before training; QB seed 42 validation at the selected epoch, against epoch 0 (C2MS)
gates.expand: an arm with validation SAM decrease >= 0.10 deg and validation PSNR >= C2MS - 0.02 dB is expanded to QB/GF2/WV3 seeds 42-44 and the WV2 transfer (after user approval)
gates.stop_information_limit: if no arm passes and every arm also lowers the training-probe SAM by < 0.10 deg, the inputs are taken as unable to predict the high-band color and the head approach is closed
gates.generalization_limit: if no arm passes but some arm lowers the training-probe SAM by >= 0.10 deg, the next design targets generalization (regularization, augmentation)

judgement.criteria: docs/judgement_criteria.md v2.3, unchanged, single seed (noise threshold 0.06 dB) against the same-seed C2MS
judgement.sam_goal: QB dSAM <= -0.15 deg (first) / <= -0.28 deg (stretch) with dPSNR >= -0.04 dB, reported separately
judgement.images: fixed six QB scenes, both formats with common/result_images.py, plus a table of the zoom-window PSNR per scene (the zoom window is chosen in favour of the candidate)

limits: single seed QB screen; the RR test set has been used repeatedly for exploration; F2/F3 add capacity behind C2MS, so a gain is not attributable to the band-ratio form alone
constraints: C2MS weights are read only; new runtime C:/CtrS-p62; caches hard-linked from C:/CtrS-p59/run after SHA-256 checks
